description: Place a Word, RTF, Excel, text or InDesign Tagged Text file (or any placeable file) with the options of its import dialog, on a page or into a frame; optionally apply a table style to imported tables and generate alt text for placed images (File > Place > Show Import Options)

autoflow.description: Autoflow text, adding pages as needed

decimalPlaces.description: Number of Decimal Places to Include

rangeName.description: Cell Range, e.g. "A1:D20" or a named range

showHiddenCells.description: Import Hidden Cells Not Saved in View

tableFormatting.description: Table: formatted, unformatted, tabbed text, or formatted once

filePath.description: The file to place (inside the allowed directories)

frameId.description: Place into this existing frame instead of onto the page

generateAltText.description: Generate alt text for placed images with Adobe's generative AI (InDesign 2026 (21.5) or later; needs sign-in and network)

keepSettings.description: Leave the import options in place for later placing (default: put the previous options back)

markGeneratedAltText.description: Tag generated alt text as generated by AI (with generateAltText)

pageIndex.description: Page to place on (0-based), unless frameId is given

tableStyle.description: Apply this table style to the tables the file brings in (Excel Import Options > Table Style)

styleConflict.description: Resolve Text Style Conflicts Using the publication or the tagged file definition

dictionary.description: Set Dictionary to: a language name, e.g. "English: USA"

spacesIntoTabsCount.description: Number of spaces to replace with a tab

stripReturnsBetweenLines.description: Extra Carriage Returns: Remove at End of Every Line

stripReturnsBetweenParagraphs.description: Extra Carriage Returns: Remove Between Paragraphs

convertPageBreaks.description: Manual Page Breaks: preserve as page or column breaks, or none

removeFormatting.description: true: Remove Styles and Formatting from Text and Tables; false: Preserve Styles and Formatting

x.description: Left of the placed content, mm from the page's left edge

y.description: Top of the placed content, mm from the page's top edge

name: place_with_import_options
title: Place With Import Options
